mode.label: View
mode.simpleTip: Three numbers and what to do, per product

stop.isOnSub: Every ad is paused. Nothing starts again until « Restart everything ».
stop.isOnLaunch: The owner stopped everything: no ad can be launched now.
stop.askText: Every running ad is paused right away. Nothing starts again, by hand or by Autopilot, until you click « Restart everything ».

guard.title: The owner’s limits
guard.maxDaily: Most the shop may spend a day
guard.launchYes: Every launch by a marketer waits for my yes
guard.launchYesTip: The marketer prepares the ad; it goes to Meta when you say yes.
guard.note: Pausing is always allowed. A marketer’s raise that is too big waits for you in « Waiting for your yes ».

account.st2: Ad account « {{name}} » is disabled by Meta: the ads do not run.
account.st3: Ad account « {{name}} » has a payment due: Meta stopped the ads.
account.st7: Ad account « {{name}} » is under review at Meta.
account.st9: Ad account « {{name}} » is in its grace period: pay the balance.
account.stx: Ad account « {{name}} » has a problem at Meta.

simple.title: My ads
simple.sub: For each product: what you spent, the delivered orders, and what one delivered order costs.
simple.noneText: Launch an ad in 4 steps: the product, what you want, the photo or video, the budget.
simple.loose: {{n}} ad(s) have no product yet: link them in the Pro view.

say.scale: It works: a delivered order costs well under your limit. You can raise the budget slowly (+20 %).
say.keep: It is fine: keep the ad as it is and look again in 2 or 3 days.
say.price: The ad costs a bit too much: raise the price by {{rise}} or change the video.
say.cutdel: Too many parcels come back: the ad loses money. Pause it and check the delivery.
say.cut: A delivered order costs more than it brings: pause the ad.
say.loss: This product loses money even without ads: pause and check its price.
say.wait: Not enough orders yet to judge: wait 2 or 3 days.

sentToOwner: Sent to the owner: they must say yes

btn.noBudget: The budget is set in Meta

budget.title: Budget of « {{name}} »
budget.campaign: This is the budget of campaign « {{name}} » (Advantage+): it changes for all its ads.
budget.over: The shop would spend {{total}} $ a day: the owner’s limit is {{max}} $.
budget.overOwner: Above your daily limit ({{max}} $): you can still do it.
budget.needsYes: Raise of more than {{pct}} %: the owner must say yes.
budget.note: Meta learns again after a big change: raise 20 % at a time, 4 times an hour at most.

where.title: Where the ads’ orders come from
where.empty: No order linked to an ad in this period.
where.hoursLabel: Orders by hour of the day
where.note: Only the orders that keep their ad’s id (sales page, Dellal, form) are counted here.

launch.title: Launch an ad
launch.sub: Everything is created paused at Meta, then turned on in one go when it is all ready.
launch.noAccount: First link the shop’s Meta ad account (Pilot AI › Accounts).
launch.noProducts: No active product: add a product first.
launch.ownerYes: The owner must say yes: the ad goes to Meta after their yes.
launch.safety: Autopilot watches the ad: if it spends too much with no order, it is paused. You can stop everything at any time.

ask.product: Which product do you want to sell?
ask.goal: What do you want people to do?
ask.ad: The photos or videos, and the words

limit.line: A delivered order may cost up to {{max}}
limit.none: This product leaves no margin: check its price.
limit.explain: From your real orders: {{delivered}} delivered, {{share}} % of parcels arrive. Above the limit, the ad loses money.

sales.name: Sales on the page
sales.text: People order on your sales page.
sales.tip: Meta looks for people who buy. It needs the product’s sales page and a pixel.

messages.name: Messages
messages.text: People write to you; Dellal answers and takes the order.
messages.tip: The easiest in Algeria: people ask their questions, Dellal (the AI) answers and creates the order.

calls.name: Calls
calls.tip: A « Call » button: someone must answer the phone.

form.name: Form
form.text: Name, number and wilaya without leaving Facebook.
form.tip: Each form becomes an order in Confirmation (Marketing › Forms).

awareness.name: Get known
awareness.text: Many people see your brand, for little money.
awareness.tip: To get known before selling: Meta shows the ad to as many people as it can.
awareness.more: Meta shows the ad to as many people as it can, for the lowest price.

traffic.name: Visits
traffic.tip: Meta looks for people who open the page (not always buyers).

engagement.name: Boost a post
engagement.text: More people see a post of your Page.
engagement.tip: Choose a post that already works.

check.title: Before launching
check.noPage: Link the Facebook Page (Pilot AI › Accounts)
check.noLanding: This product has no sales page
check.noPixel: Add a Meta pixel (Landing pages › Pixels)
check.noForm: Choose a form or give the privacy link
check.noMedia: Choose at least one photo or video

msg.dellal: Dellal (the AI) answers at once on Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp, and the order keeps the ad’s id.
msg.question: Question {{n}}

call.note: A number that answers from 9 am to 9 pm. Format: +213 6… or 06…

form.name: Form name
form.asks: It always asks: name, number, wilaya.
form.privacyNote: Meta needs it for every form.
form.toOrders: The answers become orders in Confirmation (Marketing › Forms).

post.noAd: The post keeps its photo and its words.

ad.ideaPh: Your idea (e.g. 2 for 1, free delivery in Algiers)
ad.ready: Ready sentences (no AI): change them as you like.
ad.headline: Headline (short)

media.title: Photos and videos ({{n}}/10)
media.tip: A vertical video of 15 to 30 s works best.
media.videoType: Send an MP4 or MOV video.
media.videoLost: The video could not be sent.

pro.splitTest: One ad set per photo or video (test)

who.newWilayas: Meta does not split the new wilayas yet: they cannot be left out.
who.advantageTip: Meta may go beyond your choices if it finds better buyers (advised).

test.title: Test plan (3 days)
test.note: Let it run 3 days before judging: Meta learns during that time.
test.perMedia: Each photo or video has its own ad set: {{n}} × the budget. Keep the best one after 3 days.

done.liveText: « {{name}} » is on at Meta. The first numbers come in a few hours.
done.waitingText: The owner must say yes. The ad goes to Meta right after.
done.next: Autopilot watches it from now on.

pilot.title: Autopilot
pilot.sub: It looks at your ads every 15 minutes, with your real delivered orders.
pilot.none: Nothing to do for now: your ads are fine.
pilot.ownerOnly: Only the owner changes these settings.
pilot.askOnly: This rule always asks before acting.
pilot.rulesNote: On « Auto », Autopilot acts alone within your limits: 5 changes a day at most, and no new budget change before 72 h.

stop.name: Stop the losses
stop.text: Pause when the ad spends 2 × your limit in 3 days with no order.

trim.name: Lower the budget
trim.text: −20 % when an order costs more than your limit (7 days).

deliver.name: Weak delivery
deliver.text: Warns when fewer than 55 % of parcels arrive.

confirm.name: Weak confirmation
confirm.text: Warns when fewer than 35 % of customers confirm on the phone.

tired.name: Tired creative
tired.text: Warns when the video no longer hooks or the audience is worn out.

scale.name: Raise
scale.text: +20 % when an order costs half your limit or less, with 10 orders in 7 days.

cap.name: Daily cap
cap.text: Pauses everything at your daily maximum, restarts the next morning.

why.stop: {{spend}} spent in {{days}} days with no order (limit {{limit}}).
why.deliver: Only {{rate}} % of parcels arrive ({{delivered}} of {{settled}}). Check the delivery, price or page before spending more.
why.confirm: Only {{rate}} % of customers confirm ({{yes}} of {{received}}). Check the price and what the ad promises.
why.trim: An order costs {{cost}}, the limit is {{limit}}. Budget {{from}} → {{to}} a day.
why.tired_fatigue: Fewer people watch the video than before: add a new video.
why.tired_hook: The first 3 seconds do not hook: change the start of the video.
why.tired_audience: Always the same people see the ad: make a copy for a new audience.
why.scale: An order costs {{cost}} (limit {{limit}}) with {{orders}} orders in 7 days. Budget {{from}} → {{to}} a day.

aud.title: Your customers’ audiences
aud.sub: Your own customers become Meta audiences: leave out people who return parcels or give fake numbers, and find people like your buyers.
aud.privacy: Only your shop’s customers. Numbers are hashed (SHA-256) on the server before going to Meta, never in clear.

returners.name: People who return parcels
returners.text: Customers who refused or returned a parcel this year no longer see your ads.

fake.name: Fake numbers and fake orders
fake.text: Numbers marked fake or wrong number no longer see your ads.

buyers.name: Delivered customers
buyers.text: Your delivered buyers: leave them out so you do not pay twice, and the base of the lookalike.

lookalike.name: Like my delivered customers
lookalike.text: People in Algeria who look like your delivered buyers (1 %). Needs at least 100 delivered customers.
